extracted.name: Cream-Braised Brussels Sprouts
extracted.description: Creamed Brussels sprouts are a favorite. The sprouts are simmered in heavy cream, then finished with a squeeze of fresh lemon in this delicious Thanksgiving side dish.
ingredient_lines: 1.5 pounds Brussels sprouts, trimmed and quartered
0.25 teaspoon sea salt, or to taste
2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice, or to taste
instruction_lines: Melt butter in skillet over medium-high heat. Add Brussels sprouts and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until sprouts are browned in spots, about 5 minutes.

Pour in cream, and bring to a simmer. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer until sprouts are tender and easily pierced with a fork, 30 to 35 minutes. The cream will have reduced in volume, and will have taken on a creamy beige color.
Remove the lid and stir in lemon juice. Allow sprouts to simmer a few minutes more until cream thickens and coats the sprouts.
Season to taste with additional salt and lemon juice before serving.
